title: Lifecycle of a release on the VM
caption: deploy/scripts/deploy.sh. Paths: /srv/velexis/incoming/<sha> → /srv/velexis/releases/<sha>; snapshot /var/lib/velexis/system/<sha>/; history /var/lib/velexis/deploy-history.

states.label: Packed in CI
states.detail: `release-<sha>.tar` artefact of the build job (7 days).

states.label: Uploaded (incoming/<sha>)
states.detail: Owned by `deploy`, 0750. Unused uploads older than a day are removed by the next deploy.

states.label: Refused
states.detail: Checksum, RELEASE.json, Node major or env-file check failed: nothing changed.

states.label: Installed (releases/<sha>, snapshot)
states.detail: `root:velexis`, read-only; units and Caddyfile staged from the snapshot.

states.label: Migrated
states.detail: platform, reference, tenant fan-out; report published; reference data loaded if changed.

states.label: Rolled back from
states.detail: A unit failed its health check: previous release's snapshot re-installed, `current` switched back, exit 1.

states.label: Previous (rollback target)
states.detail: `--rollback` switches back to the last activated sha different from the current one.

states.label: Pruned
states.detail: Beyond the newest five (by folder time), never the current or rollback target; its snapshot goes too.

transitions.label: migration fails: running release keeps its units; deploy again
same sha deployed again (no file changes; migrations no-op, report re-sent, every unit restarted)
